bindings.name: SENKO_AUTH_MODE
bindings.operatorAction: Set explicitly to database for managed staging/production; bootstrap is local or migration-only.

bindings.name: SENKO_DATABASE_URL
bindings.operatorAction: Create a distinct least-privilege runtime credential per environment and rotate it with database access verification.

bindings.name: SENKO_API_KEY_HASH_SECRET_V1
bindings.operatorAction: Assign an owner before staging; rotate only through a versioned key-hash migration and overlap plan.

bindings.name: SENKO_ADMIN_TOKEN
bindings.operatorAction: Assign an R0 operator owner, rotate after protected endpoint verification, and retire after customer-scoped administration exists.

bindings.name: SENKO_API_KEYS
bindings.operatorAction: Keep absent from database-mode staging/production and remove after the controlled bootstrap migration.

bindings.name: SENKO_MODELS
bindings.operatorAction: Version the approved model and pricing catalog in release evidence before changing the Dashboard value.

bindings.name: SENKO_FAST_MODEL
bindings.operatorAction: Record the resolved catalog model and compatibility impact before changing the alias.

bindings.name: SENKO_PROVIDER_ROUTES
bindings.operatorAction: Version the approved route IDs, priorities, mappings, capacity, and secret binding names without secret values.

bindings.name: SENKO_PROVIDER_KEY_OPENAI
bindings.operatorAction: Assign an owner and rotate with an overlapping provider credential plus bounded route contract test.

bindings.name: SENKO_PROVIDER_KEY_OPENROUTER
bindings.operatorAction: Assign an owner and rotate with an overlapping provider credential plus bounded route contract test.

bindings.name: SENKO_PROVIDER_KEY_DEEPSEEK
bindings.operatorAction: Assign an owner and rotate with an overlapping provider credential plus bounded route contract test.

bindings.name: SENKO_INFERENCE_ENABLED
bindings.operatorAction: Set explicitly and record every emergency disable/enable with the incident or release evidence.

bindings.name: LLM_API_BASE_URL
bindings.operatorAction: Keep absent from database-mode staging/production; use only for the documented legacy bootstrap route.

bindings.name: LLM_API_KEY
bindings.operatorAction: Keep absent from database-mode staging/production and rotate only within the legacy bootstrap procedure.

bindings.name: SENKO_ADMISSION
bindings.operatorAction: Bind a distinct Durable Object namespace in each environment and verify migration/state isolation.

bindings.name: SENKO_PROVIDER_POOLS
bindings.operatorAction: Bind a distinct Durable Object namespace in each environment and verify route-state isolation.
